title: Markets
description: A stock, an ETF or a coin and its day's change in the menu bar; click it for every symbol you follow with its price, its change and a spark line of the day, each a click from its page in the browser. Free data from Nasdaq (US stocks and ETFs) and CoinGecko (coins), in euros or your currency, no account or key.
examples: The menu bar shows SPY ▲0.28%: click it for SPY, AAPL, BTC and ETH with their prices and the day's line
Type markets: every symbol as a row; Return opens its page in the browser

preferences.name: symbols
preferences.title: Symbols
preferences.description: US stock and ETF tickers and coin symbols, in the order shown, up to 12. BTC, ETH, SOL and other big coins are known; write coin:XYZ for another coin, stock:XYZ for a stock that shares a coin's symbol.

preferences.name: pinned
preferences.title: In the menu bar
preferences.description: The symbol the menu bar shows. Empty: the first of your symbols.

preferences.name: currency
preferences.title: Currency
preferences.description: Coins are priced in it; US stocks are converted from dollars at the ECB's daily rate (shown with ≈).
